title: Guests never have to speak
text: Come and watch a whole meeting. You only step up when you feel ready.

title: Feedback that's kind
text: Every speech gets an evaluation: what worked, and one thing to try next time.

title: Every role is practice
text: Keep time, introduce a speaker, lead the meeting. Each job builds confidence.

title: Your own path
text: Toastmasters Pathways lets you choose what to work on, from storytelling to leadership.
